narrative: On the board. The same sheet, the window gone grey, the pen slower than it was at noon. On the board. One more line, and the rest of the sheet bare, the frost still in the corners of the pane.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote two lines and stopped while the light went.

entities.name: Love's Labour's Lost
entities.context: Shown on draft in The Worthies, only begun
